6dec3ca7533dabe6b025417afd5cc5520c0028e3.translatedText: **This node's own far field is always computed `abs(点高度−估计地面高度)`, with no `considerDrop` switch\.** A point that is 15 cm above the estimated ground, or 15 cm below it, will both output a height difference of 0\.15 m; when other conditions are met, either may reach the 10 cm obstacle threshold of the global costmap\.
